title: Filter pipeline values
summary: PowerShell: Filter pipeline values. Raise the limit to 9.
introduction: Where-Object keeps values that pass a rule. $_ means the current pipeline item.

blocks.text: Open PowerShell 7. Paste one example or save it as lesson.ps1 and run pwsh -NoProfile -File lesson.ps1. No administrator access is needed.
$_ is each pipeline item. Only 8 and 9 pass the -ge 7 rule.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Write the rule inside a script block with braces.
